title: A Q6 Spectral Route to the Strong Goldbach Conjecture: Spectral Non-Concentration and the Inverse-GCD Operator
desc: We reformulate the Strong Goldbach Conjecture in terms of spectral properties of the inverse-GCD operator Q_N(i,j) = 1/gcd(i,j). A Goldbach hole at k forces the prime-indicator difference vector v_k into the kernel of a local truncation of Q_N. Under the Bridge Conjecture (lambda_min(Q_N) > -1/2, equivalent to RH), this creates a structural contradiction provided v_k lies in the positive eigenspace of Q_N.
